info.name: StockFlow API
info.description: Backend for the StockFlow React app (Express + MongoDB). Run folder "1. Auth" first, then work top to bottom. Set baseUrl in the collection Variables tab if your port differs.

item.name: 1. Auth — run this folder first
item.description: Logs in as each demo role and saves the tokens ({{token}} = Admin, plus adminToken / managerToken / staffToken / salesToken).

item.name: 3. Products
item.description: Read: any role. Create / edit / delete: Admin and Warehouse Manager.

exec: pm.test('All low stock', () => pm.response.json().forEach(p => pm.expect(p.stockStatus).to.eql('Low stock')));

item.name: 4. Warehouses (+ racks, bins, warehouse inventory)
item.description: Read: any role. Changes: Admin and Warehouse Manager.

item.name: 5. Stock Movements
item.description: Create: Admin, Warehouse Manager, Inventory Staff. Each call changes real stock — check the product in Compass afterwards.

item.name: 6. Suppliers
item.description: Read: any role. Add / edit / delete: Admin and Warehouse Manager.

item.name: Delete supplier that has purchase orders (409)
7. Purchase Orders
item.description: Read: any role. Create / edit / receive / delete: Admin and Warehouse Manager. Receiving adds stock.

item.name: 8. Sales Orders
item.description: Workflow: Pending → Confirm (stock deducted) → Ship → Deliver. Cancel/Return/Delete put stock back. Create/confirm/ship/deliver: Admin, Manager, Sales Staff. Cancel/Return: Admin, Manager.

item.name: 10. Reports & Dashboard
item.description: Stock + Sales: Admin, Manager, Sales Staff. Purchase + Warehouse: Admin, Manager.

item.name: Stock report — filtered (low stock, one warehouse)
Sales Staff cannot create a product (403)
